sources.cpg_density: universe CpGs within +-500 bp, self excluded
sources.cpg_density_hg38: hg38 CG dinucleotides with C in +-500 bp window, self included
sources.gc_content: hg38 fasta, GC fraction over non-N bases in +-500 bp window
sources.tss_dist: log10(1+bp) to nearest GENCODE v50 transcript TSS (all transcripts, 388,474 TSS), from regulatory_activity/cpg_enhancer_map.parquet:dist_to_gencode_tss_bp
sources.probe_type: Infinium design type I/II from GPL21145 (EPIC v1) platform table, joined by hg38 (chrom,pos) via illumina_probe_grch38.parquet; positions not found there are filled from the EPIC v2 manifest (EPIC-8v2-0_A1.csv, GRCh38 CHR/MAPINFO; agrees with the primary route on 99.98% of overlapping CpGs). Remaining NaN = probe on no locally available manifest (documented, intentionally not imputed)
